question: Does omitting only the current remaining wall-time observation change whole-task success and cost under the same real deadline, logical budget and ordinary Python exception contract?
treatment: Measured current remaining seconds versus an explicit statement that remaining time is not exposed. Both still enforce the actual monotonic deadline. Canonical protocol references are applied in both arms before token counting; argument/content/reasoning strings are never rewritten.
comparison_scope: Ordinary visibility ablation on all four previously known tasks, not a novel control method or an exact P78 rerun. New seed57 and protocol-reference normalization are common. Historical P78 is not a causal control.
common_controls: Same public task/world, typed results, Python exceptions, all returned reasoning, persistent Python, public schemas, residual output reservation, numeric token/API budgets, canonical transport references, first request cold then warm prefix caching.
order_rule: Exactly once: task1 measured,not_exposed; task2 not_exposed,measured; task3 measured,not_exposed; task4 not_exposed,measured. No outcome-based task selection, retry, seed change or budget extension.
cache_rule: First model request cache_prompt=false and measured cache_n=0/prompt_n=full input are required. Later requests use true. Timing and numerical nondeterminism remain; identical seeds do not guarantee identical trajectories.
budget_rule: 80 calls,450000 logical input+output tokens,1800 work seconds per cell; output cap=min(4096,remaining after exact input count),context65536. API caps160 for photo and80 for each other task. Setup<=120 and cleanup<=180 seconds are separately measured. Eight cells reserve <=3600000 logical tokens; server has a21600-second finite lease.
failure_rule: Preserve all attempts. Unknown terminal model usage ends the cell with no response execution or retry. If API effects and cleanup are known, wait<=60s for the same idle server, independently evaluate once and continue the fixed next cell. Unknown API effects, cache mismatch, initialization/runtime/cleanup/evaluation failure, changed server or insufficient lease stops the batch. Never impute missing usage as zero.
primary_cost: All newly generated full logical input+output tokens from task start, including reasoning, control notices, failed attempts and recovery. Unknown terminal use prevents an exact task total. Also report cached/noncached input, output, model and API calls, work/setup/cleanup/evaluation/model-load/server residency wall separately. No tokens-to-money or time equivalence.
primary_quality: One official final task-success boolean per frozen cell, with no evaluator feedback returned to the model. No hidden criteria or individual answers inspected.
analysis_rule: Publish all8cells and4pairs including failures and unknown usage. Full logical token deltas only for complete known totals. Record visible/measured budget, sent inputs, actual API exceptions, first public divergence and model/API counts. A hidden-clock condition may still vary from GPU arithmetic, prefix cache, real deadline and different prior outputs; do not claim deterministic identical execution.
development_gate: All8evaluated with clean audit and known totals; not_exposed has no per-task success loss and strictly lower aggregate whole-task logical cost. This is only a descriptive development gate, not statistical noninferiority, generalization, novelty or acceptance evidence.
